title: Simultaneous compact descent of pointwise pushout data
statement:
Work in a fixed universe. Let $\kappa$ be uncountable regular and let $\mathcal A$ be an ordinary locally $\kappa$-presentable category with small Hom sets and colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. This means every object is a small $\kappa$-filtered colimit of a small family of $\kappa$-presentable objects; $\kappa$-presentable means that the ordinary Hom functor preserves such colimits, regular means unions of fewer than $\kappa$ sets of size less than $\kappa$ have size less than $\kappa$, and $\kappa$-filtered means every diagram with fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms admits a cocone. Let $D$ have fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms. Assume every $D$-diagram in $\mathcal A$ is a small $\kappa$-filtered colimit of pointwise $\kappa$-presentable diagrams, and that finite colimits of $\kappa$-presentable objects of $\mathcal A$ are $\kappa$-presentable.

Let $f:F\to G$ be a natural transformation such that for every $d$ there is a pushout square with top $u_d:P_d\to Q_d$, bottom $f(d):F(d)\to G(d)$, and left $a_d:P_d\to F(d)$, where $P_d,Q_d$ are $\kappa$-presentable. The arrows $u_d$ and $a_d$ are not required to form natural transformations. Then there exist diagrams $F_0,G_0$, a natural transformation $h:F_0\to G_0$ and a map $F_0\to F$ such that $f$ is the pushout of $h$ along this map in $\operatorname{Fun}(D,\mathcal A)$, both $F_0,G_0$ are pointwise $\kappa$-presentable, and for every $d$, $h(d)$ is a pushout of the same specified $u_d$ along a map $P_d\to F_0(d)$ factoring $a_d$. No monomorphism assumption on $u_d$, $f(d)$, or the filtered transition maps is imposed.
